name: Fulbright-Nehru Doctoral Research Fellowship
funder: United States-India Educational Foundation (USIEF) / Fulbright Program
amount: Monthly stipend, round-trip economy airfare, J-1 visa support, accident and sickness cover, applicable allowances (no dependent allowance)
other_rules: Indian citizens registered for a PhD at an Indian institution by 1 November of the year before the deadline
not for those who already hold a PhD or are about to submit the thesis
expected thesis submission at least 3 months after the grant ends
central and state government civil servants not eligible (researchers at CSIR, ICAR, IISc, IITs etc. are eligible)
employed applicants need employer endorsement of leave
only one Fulbright-Nehru category per cycle
2027-28 cycle limited to priority fields (life sciences only via bioengineering)
notes: Stays of 6-9 months in the US. 2027-28 cycle opened 18 Feb 2026 and closed 1 Jul 2026; the 2028-29 cycle is expected on a similar timeline, but check whether the priority-field list changes. Needs a recommendation letter from the PhD supervisor and a writing sample of up to 20 pages.

documents.name: Writing sample
documents.notes: Published or presented paper, or extract from Master's/MPhil thesis

documents.name: Recommendation letter from PhD supervisor
documents.notes: Must cover research, need for fellowship, registration date and topic
